in_sanskrit.name: Ashadul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Night Moon
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ashadul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ashadul is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Asha' (meaning night) and 'Dul' (meaning moon). The name is often used in Hindu mythology to refer to the goddess of the night, Chandra.
